mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_ai_log_issue_group WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_ai_log_issue_group SET active_ai_item_id = #{itemId}, ai_status = 'WAITING', lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND active_ai_item_id IS NULL
mapper.sql: UPDATE tb_ai_log_issue_group issue JOIN tb_ai_log_ai_task_item item ON item.id = issue.active_ai_item_id SET issue.ai_status = CASE item.status WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'WAITING' END, issue.current_ai_item_id = CASE WHEN item.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN item.id ELSE issue.current_ai_item_id END, issue.active_ai_item_id = CASE WHEN item.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED') THEN NULL ELSE item.id END, issue.lock_version = issue.lock_version + 1
